description: What a patch release (x.y.Z, Z > 0) publishes besides the modules that changed since the previous release of its line (.forgejo/scripts/patch-plan.py). Each entry is a reactor folder, published at the patch version every time because a published artifact names it by a version it does not declare itself: an application builds on the BOM's version, the plugin's and the CLI's; the plugin resolves the dev agent and the core's -codegen at the version of vidocq-runtime-core, the test agent at its own version, the dev console at the version of vidocq-runtime-chappe-webserver-extension; the banner shows the version of vidocq-runtime-core. The build root (".", io.vidocq:vidocq-build) carries the aggregate CycloneDX SBOM of the release (#796): it moves to the patch version alone (patch-versions.py of Vidocq/ci), and its SBOM lists what the patch publishes and what that depends on; .forgejo/scripts/scan-released-sboms.py adds the modules the patch's BOM keeps at an earlier version from the release that published them.
